scenes.title: The circuit for this input
scenes.note: H on every qubit, then oracle (X on the 0-bits of each marked string, a multi-controlled Z, X again) and diffuser (H, X, multi-controlled Z, X, H), repeated. Multi-controlled Z = H · MCX · H. r.code() prints it as an hdqs chain.

scenes.title: Start: equal superposition
scenes.note: Hadamards on all 3 qubits give every one of the 8 answers the same amplitude 1/√8. The state sits at angle θ = 20.7° above "all wrong answers".

scenes.title: Iteration 1 · oracle marks the answer
scenes.note: The oracle flips the sign of |101⟩. Geometrically this is a reflection in the "wrong answers" axis (dashed mirror).

scenes.title: Iteration 1 · inversion about the mean
scenes.note: Every amplitude is reflected about the mean (dashed line): the marked one grows, the rest shrink. Geometrically: a reflection in the start direction |s⟩.

scenes.title: Iteration 2 · oracle marks the answer
scenes.note: The oracle flips the sign of |101⟩. Geometrically this is a reflection in the "wrong answers" axis (dashed mirror).

scenes.title: Iteration 2 · inversion about the mean
scenes.note: Every amplitude is reflected about the mean (dashed line): the marked one grows, the rest shrink. Geometrically: a reflection in the start direction |s⟩.

scenes.title: Measure
scenes.note: 1024 shots: 101 appeared 978 times. Success probability 0.945 after 2 iterations (a classical search needs about 4 tries on average).
